description: How far along a track (0-1) the moment t (epoch seconds) is, pointAt's inverse: where a photo's slider starts. A moment before or after the track is at its end. Points are { lon, lat, t }, t in epoch seconds.

cases.name: halfway through the first leg is a quarter of the way
halfway through the second leg is three quarters
anywhere in the stop is the stop
before the track is its start
after the track is its end
a track with no length goes by time
